rationale.web: The commercial web workload includes the Next.js standalone server and the exact OCCT kernel fallback. The 1536 MB alert budget is above the 1037.4 MB release-candidate peak while retaining 32.5 percent workload headroom; the Railway metric must also prove that the runtime limit is at least this budget.
rationale.openscad-worker: The isolated OpenSCAD worker remains a bounded command worker; 512 MB preserves the original release target.
rationale.fea-worker: The isolated Gmsh/CalculiX worker keeps a 2048 MB budget for solver mesh growth.

nonClaims: This policy does not replace the seven-day observation requirement.
The memory budget is an alert/release threshold, not a claim that the service reserves that amount.
A dedicated exact-CAD worker remains the preferred scale-out boundary if sustained concurrency exceeds the qualified release workload.
